summary.text: Robert Flournoy is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 74 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Flournoy as Robert Flournoy Jr.; he succeeded Karen Mathiak in District 74, assuming office on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee, the State Planning and Community Affairs Committee and the State Properties Committee.
